title: Cutover Ops Micro-Playbook
content:
Purpose: quick, single-screen reference for my release day run (personal notes + prioritized TODOs). Use this as the source-of-truth for immediate actions; longer runbook in Confluence if we need formal steps.

TL;DR run order (priority):
1) Validate infra health + redis/kafka consumers (pre-cutover)
2) Deploy model server image to canary pool (10%)
3) Smoke test generation path + embeddings path
4) Promote if stable, otherwise rollback to previous tagged image

Morning prep (T-3h to T-1h) — check boxes:
- [ ] Confirm on-call list and escalation contacts (Slack #oncall, phone numbers)
- [ ] Ensure reserved capacity is available for Dedicated customers (check Dedicated dashboard)
- [ ] Pull latest build artifacts: digest sha from CI (cd artifacts && ls -lt)
- [ ] Verify canary nodes have minimum logs volume (grafana: logs/canary)
- [ ] Create a new temporary slack thread pinned to #cutover (start message below)

Commands I usually run (copy/paste):
- kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=model-server -o wide
- gcloud compute ssh canary-01 --command "sudo journalctl -u model-server -n 200"
- ./scripts/validate_endpoints.sh https://api.redwood.internal:443 
- curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"smoke test\"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' | jq '.'

Canary checklist (T-30m -> T+20m):
- [ ] Deploy image to canary: tag = rc-20251103-<sha>
- [ ] Wait until readiness_count == desired_count (monitor pod readiness)
- [ ] Run 50 short generation requests (s = ./tools/batch_smoke -n 50)
- [ ] Run 20 embedding requests and compare to baseline EMB_BASE_202510 (expect cosine >= 0.92)
- [ ] Check latency p95 < 350ms for gen; if >350ms, capture flamegraph and abort

Contingency & rollback criteria:
- Rollback immediately if any of:
  * 5% of smoke responses are 500s
  * p95 latency > 600ms for >5min
  * any Dedicated customer reports errors in first 15 minutes
- Rollback steps (fast):
  1) kubectl set image deployment/model-server model-server=redwood/model-server:<prev-tag> -n prod
  2) kubectl rollout status deployment/model-server -n prod --timeout=10m
  3) Post message to #prod-incidents and #cutover with rollback summary

Backports and patches (my short list):
- RINF-2345: CLI telemetry bug (PR #812) — cherry-pick to release branch if green
- RINF-2351: kv-cache eviction tweak (needs QA signoff) — prepare hotfix tag rc-hotfix-2351
- RINF-2360: small logging tweak (non-blocker)
Notes: prioritize 2345 first (affects streaming logs), 2351 only if p95 drift appears during canary.

Comms (who to ping & example messages):
- Slack thread name: "Cutover: rc-20251103-<sha>" pinned in #cutover
- Pre-cutover (T-45m) message: "Cutover starting at T (UTC 15:30). Monitoring channels: #cutover, #oncall. If you see errors tag @oncall and @release-lead."
- Post-cutover (T+30m) message template: "Promoted rc-20251103-<sha> to production. Canary passed (smoke/embedding/latency). Rolling forward to 100%.": include short metrics snippet

Escalation contacts (fast):
- Oncall infra: Ethan Morales (slack @ethan), phone +1-415-555-0192
- SRE lead: Priya Nair (slack @priya), pager +1-415-555-0177
- Release lead: Samira Dutta (me) slack @sami

Post-cutover validation (T+30m -> T+2h):
- [ ] Verify traffic ramp to 100% succeeded (traffic-split service)
- [ ] Run dataset regression subset (evals/run_eval --suite=critical_prompts) — expect no severe semantic regressions
- [ ] Check billing spike anomalies (billing dashboard) — if >20% lift, check batching config and logs
- [ ] Confirm no new 5xx alerts in last 1h across all regions

Open questions / TODOs (personal):
- Check whether we can temporarily increase KV cache TTL for dedicated customers during cutover to reduce misses (ask infra team)
- Confirm backup snapshot cadence (T-2h snapshot exists?)
- Decide on delayed rollout for APAC region if US/EU show transient errors

Random notes / memory aids (my shorthand):
- "P95 spike" usually = kernel scheduling or slow remote store (look at redis latency)
- If embedding drift -> check model shard alignment and quantization parameters
- Keep a small buffer of capacity: set autoscaler min_replicas += 2 for 45m

After-action quick log (template to fill in):
- Cutover start: 
- Canary results: pass/fail + notes
- Rollout time to 100%:
- Any rollbacks? (Y/N + why)
- Follow-ups (tickets created):

Notes to self: keep this doc short and eyeballable. Move the long checklist to Confluence only after the run is clean.

-- Samira
